summary.text: Tracy Brown-May is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 42 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit executive.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Brown-May graduated from Ware High School in 1985, earned an associate degree from the College of Southern Nevada in 2015, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northeastern University in 2021.
Her career experience includes working as director of advocacy, board, and government relations and as special assistant to the president and CEO of Opportunity Village.
The Clark County Commission appointed her to the Assembly on February 2, 2021, following the resignation of Alexander Assefa, and she assumed office on February 8, 2021.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Growth and Infrastructure, Health and Human Services (as chair), and Ways and Means committees.
Her Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Christopher Brandlin.
